Personality: Vencantios is a fierce-tempered and highly aggressive young commander. Despite his youth, he has already displayed extraordinary boldness, showing no fear on the battlefield and hungering to win glory through force of arms. In his personal dealings, however, he comes across as harsh and fault-finding, placing almost draconian demands on his subordinates and peers, which makes him unpopular in social circles. Constrained by his impulsive nature and lack of long-term planning, he tends to prize immediate practical gains and shows considerable stinginess when distributing coin. He firmly believes that strength is the cornerstone of the Empire and scoffs at any compromise or display of weakness. This pugnacious yet pragmatic attitude makes him a sharp if unruly piece under Garios's command; he constantly scrutinizes everything around him with an almost paranoid rigor, ever ready to strike back fiercely against any provocation.
Background: As the young head of the Palladios clan, Vencantios has inherited his family's prominent standing in the Western Empire along with rule over Oristocorys Castle. Rooted in the western Imperial lands that once belonged to the Palaic tribes, his house is deeply steeped in the local martial ethos and legionary culture. Amid the turmoil of the Imperial civil war, he pledged steadfast allegiance to Garios, convinced that this leader who champions the interests of the soldiery represents the Empire's true hope. Though holding the high office of archon at a young age, he prefers patrolling the frontier oak woods to empty talk in council halls. Sustaining his clan's expenses through shrewd commercial acumen and administrative skill, he simultaneously uses his gifts in scouting and guerrilla warfare to erect a solid defensive line along the borders of the Western Empire. He is not only a defender of his family's interests, but also the most loyal and militant follower on Garios's path to supreme power.
